arguments.text:
Hi Dana,

Thanks for the details and for providing the project ID (PRJ-5521) — that helped us track down the issue.

We've identified the cause: exports above ~5,000 rows were hitting the server's request timeout limit, which is why your larger projects were failing while smaller ones succeeded. We've increased the timeout for CSV exports and are rolling out a fix that processes large exports in the background, so exports of any size should now complete reliably.

In the meantime, the workaround we mentioned (splitting exports by date range in Settings > Export) remains a good option.

Could you try exporting PRJ-5521 again and let us know if it completes successfully? If you run into any further issues, just reply here and we'll take a look.

Best regards
Support Team

Hi Dana,

Thanks for the follow-up and for sharing the project id (PRJ-5521). We've reproduced the timeout on exports over ~5,000 rows and are working on a fix.

In the meantime, as a workaround you can split the export by date range in Settings > Export, which keeps each export under the timeout threshold.

We'll update you here with progress and a target timeline. No need to send more details unless we reach out.

Best regards,
Support Team

Hi Dana,

Thanks for the patience and for sharing the project id (PRJ-5521) — that helped us reproduce the issue.

Good news: we've identified the root cause. Exports over ~5,000 rows were hitting the synchronous 30-second timeout. We've deployed a fix that processes large exports asynchronously, so they'll now complete in the background and notify you when the CSV is ready to download.

In the meantime, the workaround we mentioned (splitting the export by date range in Settings > Export) still works if you need results before the update reaches your account.

Could you let us know once you've tried a fresh export on PRJ-5521 so we can confirm it's resolved on your end? If you still see any issues, just reply here and we'll take another look.

Best regards,
Support Team

Hi Dana,

We've confirmed the CSV export timeout on large projects and identified the root cause: the export job was hitting a server-side time limit on datasets over ~5,000 rows. A fix is being rolled out that moves large exports to run in the background, so they'll complete without timing out.

In the meantime, as a workaround you can still split the export by date range in Settings > Export (as mentioned earlier), which keeps each batch under the limit.

We'll update you here once the fix is live — expected within the next few days. No action needed on your end.

Best,
Support Team
